text: Automation levels: Level 1 individual drive and valve control (open / close, start / stop with interlocks); Level 2 group control (subsystem sequences with permissives, start of a redundant pump group on standby); Level 3 unit coordination (start-up, load control, shutdown, fuel transfer). Every level can be operated from the operator station in manual, automatic or step mode; a failure of a higher level shall leave the lower levels in the last state and operable.
